name: eder-motion
description: Eder: A quieter way to read. Ten-second product motion video.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts EderPromo out/eder-10s.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --concurrency=2 && npm run finish
scripts.finish: ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/eder-10s.mp4 -map 0:v -map 0:a -c:v copy -af volume=10dB -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 10 -movflags +faststart out/eder-10s-final.mp4
